summary: Verified Jan 2026 perf/reliability batch (health endpoint, $text search, cache headers, frontend keep-alive + retry + niche switch + search). 18/18 backend pytest passed; all frontend flows passed without 5xx errors or blank states.
critical_code_review_comments: Keep-alive ping fires on every visibilitychange event AND on a 4-min interval. During a short browse session 10 pings fired across navigations — not a bug but tighten the visibility handler to only ping if >N seconds since last ping to avoid spamming /api/health on tab-flicker.

Frontend cachedGet retry path (apiCache.js lines 87-101) looks correct: 1 retry, 500ms then 1s back-off, retries on 5xx/network/ECONNABORTED. Did not exercise the 503 path via Playwright route interception this iteration — backend was warm and no 5xx happened naturally — but logic is sound by inspection.

products.py search branch (lines 246-261) correctly uses $text only for len>=3 AND alphanumeric present, else $regex fallback. Verified with serum/cream/lakme (200) and 'la'/'a%' (200, falls back). product_text_search index confirmed covering name+brand+description+tags (server.py via products.ensure_indexes).

Cache-Control verified via localhost:8001: /api/categories and /api/concerns return 'public, max-age=300, stale-while-revalidate=600'; /api/niches returns 'public, max-age=600, stale-while-revalidate=1200' — exactly as spec. External edge proxy may strip these (out of code scope).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (homepage, /shop, /skincare, /cosmetics, /search all rendered; keep-alive ping fired; 28 serum results)

test_credentials: n/a — no auth flows touched in this batch
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_perf_reliability_jan2026.py is reusable for regression. Health endpoint, $text/$regex search branch, Cache-Control headers on categories/concerns/niches, and filter regressions all verified. Local backend reachable at http://localhost:8001 from this env. Preview DB has ~28 serum-matching products. Frontend keep-alive /api/health fires on mount and every 4 min + on every visibilitychange (visible).
